verdict: Only with deep pockets or a sharp niche. NOCD pitched a no-carb, five-calorie energy drink on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Energy drinks are one of the fastest-growing beverage categories in India, but Red Bull, Monster, Sting and Campa spend enormous sums on marketing and shelf space.
angle: Young buyers, gamers, gym-goers and students drink energy drinks more often, and sugar-free versions are growing fastest. FSSAI sets caffeine limits and labelling rules for these drinks. A small brand can win a niche, such as gaming or fitness, with sampling and community events before trying retail.

faq_extra.q: Are there caffeine limits for energy drinks in India?
faq_extra.a: Yes. FSSAI caps caffeine in caffeinated beverages and requires warning labels, including that the drink isn't recommended for children and pregnant women. Check the current limit with your formulator.
